Autosave and stop

Supervisor snapshots storage every 30s by default,
on SIGUSR2 (crumb sync) and on SIGTERM (crumb
close), merging changes into the vault. A failed
autosave is only logged.
Source: src/session.ts
Startup handshake

CLI polls for the run handle (pid + CDP URLs) for
up to 60s; supervisor writes an error file on
failure, else CLI reports 'did not start'.
Source: src/session.ts
Key fails closed

If the vault exists but its key is missing from
keychain/secret-service/CRUMB_KEY, crumb throws
KEY_UNAVAILABLE instead of creating a new key.
